presentation.label: CONTROL IN ACTIONS
presentation.summary: An ACTION mode for EXP/CV IN 1 and 2: a gate or footswitch holds or toggles the MUTE screen or live recording, or holds or latches FILL.
presentation.overview: Stock's CONTROL INPUT menus get a fourth MODE, ACTION. Pick what the input does in the ACTION row: MUTE HLD shows the MUTE screen while the input is high and goes back to the mode you were in when it drops, MUTE TGL opens and closes it, REC HLD records live while the input is high, REC TGL turns live recording on and off, FILL HLD holds FILL, FILL LAT latches and unlatches it. Live recording starts a stopped sequencer and never stops it, and ends back in grid or step recording if you were in it. A 0 to 5 V gate works as it is; for a footswitch, ACTION LEARN reads its two levels. Bars beside the menu show the input against the learned levels and whether it counts as pressed. Each jack has its own MODE, so one can switch while the other still plays the kit's CV or expression macro.
highlights: Hands-free mutes with both hands on the pads
Set up in stock's own CONTROL INPUT menus, saved with them
Works with a 0 to 5 V gate or a footswitch
usage: Plug a footswitch or a 0 to 5 V gate into EXP/CV IN 1, then open GLOBAL > CONTROL > CONTROL INPUT 1 and turn MODE past EXPR to ACTION.
Choose ACTION LEARN, press the switch a few times and press YES. If the bars' right-hand line drops with your foot off the switch, choose REVERSE DIRECTION.
Set the ACTION row to MUTE HLD, leave the menu and play: hold the switch and tap pads to mute them, let go to go back to playing.
Set it to REC TGL: a tap starts live recording, even from stop, and the next tap leaves it while the pattern plays on.

steps: Connect a gate or footswitch to EXP/CV IN 1 or 2.
Open GLOBAL > CONTROL > CONTROL INPUT 1 (or 2) and set MODE to ACTION.
Set ACTION to MUTE HLD, MUTE TGL, REC HLD, REC TGL, FILL HLD or FILL LAT.
For a footswitch, run ACTION LEARN, press it a few times and YES; if the bars' line drops with your foot off it, set REVERSE DIRECTION.

limitations: Stay within the jack's -5 V to +5 V.
The input is read 1,500 times a second; after each switch it is not read for 10 ms, so a footswitch that bounces longer than that can play an action twice.
A jack in ACTION mode plays no CONTROL IN MOD macro. Without the module, a unit left in ACTION mode reads that jack as nothing.

claims: ui:GLOBAL > CONTROL > CONTROL INPUT 1 and 2: MODE ACTION and its ACTION list
input:EXP/CV IN 1 and 2 in ACTION mode

load.display: About 0.5 % of the audio block per jack in ACTION mode, 0.1 % with ACTION OFF (measured on a unit)
load.conditions: Measured on an Analog Rytm MKII with a private telemetry base, sequencer stopped, in the author's 16-module set (0.1.2, LR02): with a jack in ACTION mode and an action, the audio handler took 3.6 us a block (0.54 %); with both jacks at ACTION OFF, 0.81 us (0.12 %), the handler's call and the timing itself. 0.1.3 changes only the UI tick and the RECORD key, not the audio path.

hardware.summary: npp1993 reports that on an Analog Rytm MKII with OS 1.74, in CK01 (this source with Loop Sync 0.3.2, QPER Live Rec 0.2.0, Quick Mod Assign 0.2.0 and Audio In Routing 0.1.0, booted from RAM over the flashed OS), a footswitch on CONTROL INPUT 1 played MUTE TGL, MUTE HLD, REC TGL, REC HLD, FILL HLD and FILL LAT as the panel's keys do, and REC TGL with QPER held on the SRC page started live recording rather than QPER Live Rec's clear. All passed.
limitations: Tested in a five-mod set only, not alone; CONTROL INPUT 2, a gate source and a power cycle not run on 0.1.4. That Loop Sync, Audio In Routing and the base's send pages now see the keys was observed in rytm-emu only: their page flags draw nothing on the unit's screens. Firmware was not read back from the device.

tests.summary: Author's unit: CI06, CI07 and CI09 alone passed every action, both learns, REVERSE DIRECTION, the bars and a power cycle. 0.1.1 reads the jacks in the audio interrupt (rytm-emu: 0.02 to 1.12 ms from edge to action). 0.1.2 in LP01, a 16-module set: ACTION OFF plays nothing, 0.8 µs a block. 0.1.3: grid and step return, RC36 pass. 0.1.4: in CK01, a five-mod set, every action by footswitch as from the panel, and REC TGL with QPER held still records, as reported.
